pirati: Original pirate adventure. Ground the subject on a wooden ship deck or sandy cove shoreline. If people appear in the photo, dress them in a simple pirate vest and sash belt (never add pirate hats, bandanas, or eye patches onto heads; keep real hair and any real cap from the photo untouched). Core scene elements: gentle ocean waves and a friendly wooden sailing ship or treasure chest nearby. Optional secondary details for older age groups: a cheerful parrot perched on a rail or chest (never on heads), palm island on the horizon, puffy clouds, and seashells.
unicorni: Enchanted unicorn meadow. Ground the subject on a soft grassy hill path. If people appear in the photo, dress them in a simple fairytale tunic or dress (never add crowns, horns, or flower wreaths onto heads; keep real hair and any real cap/headband from the photo untouched). Core scene elements: a friendly unicorn with a wavy mane and spiral horn beside the subject, plus a bold rainbow arch in the sky. Optional secondary details for older age groups: fluffy clouds, large meadow flowers, butterflies, simple star shapes, and a small fairytale turret on a distant hill.
draghi: Original dragon kingdom. Ground the subject on a smooth stone path or grassy ridge. If people appear in the photo, dress them in a simple medieval explorer tunic with a short cape (never add helmets, hoods, or hats onto heads; keep real hair and any real cap from the photo untouched). Core scene elements: a big friendly smiling dragon with open wings and a curled tail beside the subject, plus rounded mountain peaks. Optional secondary details for older age groups: a stone castle tower on a cliff, large crystal gems, pine trees, and drifting clouds.
spazio: Space adventure. Ground the subject on a gentle curved moon surface with smooth craters. If people appear in the photo, dress them in a simple astronaut suit from the neck down with NO helmet on their head (keep real hair and any real cap/glasses from the photo completely uncovered). Core scene elements: a friendly classic rocket ship and a ringed planet with bold stars in a white sky (keep the sky background pure white, never filled black). Optional secondary details for older age groups: a cute small friendly alien waving nearby, extra planets, and a simple satellite.
dinosauri: Prehistoric jungle. Ground the subject on a wide clearing or sandy trail. If people appear in the photo, dress them in a simple safari explorer vest (never add explorer hats or helmets onto heads; keep real hair and any real cap from the photo untouched). Core scene elements: a friendly smiling long-necked dinosaur or baby triceratops standing nearby, plus bold tropical palm or fern leaves framing the sides. Optional secondary details for older age groups: a gentle steaming volcano in the distance, prehistoric eggs in a nest, and stepping stones.
principessa: Fairytale kingdom. Ground the subject on a garden courtyard path. If people appear in the photo, dress them in a simple royal gown, tunic, or cape (never add crowns, tiaras, or veils onto heads; keep real hair and any real cap/headband from the photo untouched). Core scene elements: a storybook castle with flags in the background and cheerful garden flowers. Optional secondary details for older age groups: a pumpkin carriage or friendly pony nearby, a simple fountain, and butterflies.
